personality.buyer: Administrators, IT teams, MSSPs, and security/compliance stakeholders managing firewall visibility and network control
personality.emotion: Assured, vigilant, technically credible, and in-control
personality.reasoning: Firewall Analyzer is a security operations product, so the visual language should communicate trust, precision, monitoring, and compliance. The landing page needs a strong enterprise feel without becoming overly dark or generic. I’m using a structured, dashboard-led system with high contrast, layered panels, and active data motifs to make the product feel intelligent, premium, and operationally useful. Since the content emphasizes logs, monitoring, reporting, and policy management, the design should lean into clarity, signals, and control rather than marketing flourish.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is long and needs to stay authoritative while fitting cleanly in a split layout without feeling cramped.

colours.colourReason: Deep navy establishes authority and compliance confidence, while Techjockey orange provides a crisp action accent for CTAs and highlights. The light body background keeps the page premium and readable, and white cards preserve the enterprise-dashboard clarity expected for firewall monitoring tools.

backgroundSystem.hero: Deep navy base with a subtle radial glow, faint grid lines, and translucent dashboard shards
backgroundSystem.section1: Soft grey awards/proof band with white pill badges and divider lines
backgroundSystem.section2: White feature section with crisp cards and hover elevation
backgroundSystem.section3: Very light navy-tinted compliance/reporting band with split panels and metric chips

layout.heroBackground: Dark navy hero with layered abstract firewall UI shell and floating metric chips
layout.heroReason: A split layout best supports a premium technical product: clear messaging on the left, and an intelligent product visualization on the right. Since a UI screenshot may be limited, the right side should be built as a CSS-driven dashboard collage with log lines, charts, and alert cards.
layout.featureReason: The content has multiple feature groups with strong hierarchy. Use a spotlight panel for core capability messaging, followed by a grid of cards and a tabbed/segmented visual treatment for compatibility, monitoring, compliance, and reporting.
layout.darkSectionFor: Hero and one mid-page intelligence/compliance section to create contrast and reinforce the security theme

personality.imageryDirection: Use a layered firewall analytics composition rather than lifestyle photography: PNG UI panels, SVG line icons, floating alert chips, log timeline strips, and compliance badges. If a product screenshot is available, place it as a central angled monitor frame with supplementary data cards around it. For stronger visual richness, add CSS-based radar sweeps, segmented charts, and translucent panels with depth. Logos and icons should be SVG, while UI/product visuals should be PNG; use JPEG only if a large hero-style screen capture is needed.
personality.designPersonality: A precise, high-trust security dashboard aesthetic: calm under pressure, visually intelligent, and built for administrators who value immediate clarity, proof, and control.
